subject: Request: approval for combined promo bundle (discount + credits) - Thermostat AI
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ellen Cho <ellen.cho@thermostat.ai>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.m@thermostat.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Thermostat AI - combined promo ask (discount + credits)

Hi Olga / Marissa —

Quick background: Thermostat AI (Ellen / Rajiv) is running a 90-day pilot integrating our hosted API for their in-app assistant. They are enthusiastic about performance but the procurement team flagged budget for the first paid quarter. Customer is asking for a combined commercial sweetener to accelerate commitment: 30% off list rates for the first 6 months + $50k in hosted credits to use in their first 90 days.

Why I think it's worth approving:
- ARR upside: they are targeting a $600k annual commitment on completion of pilot (forecasted close Q3).
- Technical fit: They need low-latency streaming for edge fleet demos; our Redwood runtime is a strong differentiator.
- Risk: Moderate — they will need SOC 2 evidence and a short SOW (attached).

Ask: Olga/Marissa — can we get exec sign-off on a one-time combined concession (30% discount + $50k credits) contingent on SOW and 12-month minimum subscription? If yes, I will send a formal amendment.

Attachments: thermostat-deal-summary-jan12.pdf, SOW-draft-v2.docx

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Thermostat AI - combined promo ask (discount + credits)

Jonas — forwarding for visibility and approval. Ben is asking for a bundle: 30% off for 6 months + $50k hosted credits for the pilot period. Forecasted first-year net ARR ~ $450–600k if they convert.

Notes:
- Customer requests faster procurement; they want a contract ready by end of month.
- Legal flagged a short SOW; CS will own onboarding.
- We should include a clause that credits expire at 90 days unless they convert.

I recommend approval with the following guardrails: 12-month minimum term, credits expire if invoice not paid within 60 days of pilot end, and SOC 2 evidence to be provided prior to production access.

Can you OK or suggest changes?

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Sales Operations (Enterprise)
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Thermostat AI - combined promo ask (discount + credits)

Thanks for the summary. I support a constrained concession here. Approve subject to the following being documented in the amendment:
- 30% off list pricing applied to invoice months 1–6 only
- $50,000 in hosted credits issued as one-time promo, valid for 90 days from activation and extinguished on conversion (not refundable)
- 12-month committed minimum revenue, early termination provisions preserved
- Customer to sign SOW and provide SOC 2 evidence or escalate to Security for limited sandbox access

Marissa — please confirm Legal/Finance wording and Ben, proceed to get customer concurrence.

Jonas
VP, Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Jan 2028 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Thermostat AI - combined promo ask (discount + credits)

Ben / Olga — I spoke with Legal and Finance. We can approve the bundle with the controls Jonas listed. A couple of small edits to protect revenue:
- Cap the promo credits to token-type usage defined in SOW so it cannot be reallocated (we'll list embeddings + chat gen units only).
- Add a rollback clause: if customer does not sign a paid order by 120 days after pilot start, we will invoice for any consumed tokens at standard retail rates (minus any unapplied credit).

Once Ben gets customer verbal accept, I will draft the amendment language and loop in Legal for a final signoff. Proceed to finalize SOW with Ellen and Rajiv.

Marissa Cole
Head of Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Ellen Cho <ellen.cho@thermostat.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.m@thermostat.ai>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jan 2028 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Thermostat AI - combined promo ask (discount + credits)

Hi Ben / Olga — thank you, this looks very workable. We appreciate Redwood moving quickly. Ellen here — procurement has reviewed the proposed concession and asks only that the credit expiration be 90 days from activation and that we receive the signed amendment by Feb 5 to avoid procurement re-review.

We are comfortable with the 12-month commitment and the technical gating for SOC 2 documentation. Please send the amendment and SOW and we'll aim to sign.

Best,
Ellen Cho
Head of Platform Partnerships
Thermostat AI
